Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of size N(with both positive and negative integers), print the product of the elements in the maximum product subarray.
input_spec: The input consists of a number N and an array of size N with both positive and negative integers. N is between 1 and 100000 (inclusive).
output_spec: The output is the product of the elements in the maximum product subarray.
